name: Service status
description: Up or down tiles for your own services, checked from the Vital Signs server.

options.label: Services, one per line as: Name | address
options.help: Web addresses are fetched (Plex | http://192.168.1.20:32400/identity). A bare IP address or name is pinged (Router | 192.168.1.1). To test that a port answers, use tcp:// (NAS | tcp://192.168.1.5:445). The server does the checking, so use addresses it can reach.

options.label: Show a summary line (All up / 2 down)
Put services that are down first
Count a login prompt (401 or 403) as up
Seconds to wait for each service
